| `../res/icons/*.png` (leaf, scale, bolt, thermo, fan, cpu, gpu) | The window's icons, 256 px masks (white with transparency), tinted when drawn. Embedded in the exe. **scale** and **bolt** are made from the Phosphor "fill" SVGs `scales-fill` and `lightning-fill`: drawn at 1024 px, corners rounded slightly (a closing then an opening with a disc of radius 3 of 256 units). The scale is redrawn level from the same parts (pole, base, 16-unit beam, the right pan copied to both sides at the average height, pan tips cut at the beam's top), thickened by 5 units, outer corners rounded 6 units. The bolt is turned 15° so it stands upright, its outline grown by 10 units with round joins, inner corners rounded by the same amount, then fitted to 218 of 256 units tall. **leaf** (a sprout, its stem 26 units wide like the scale's pole, its end fully round), **thermo** and **fan** are drawn for this app (circles, rounded rectangles and straight cuts, 24-unit parts, corners rounded 6 units); scale, thermo and fan were then stretched halfway toward square (the width:height ratio moved to its square root, area kept). **cpu** and **gpu** were drawn by the project's owner as square drawings that fill their box edge to edge: the cpu's pins end 28 of 512 units from the edge; the gpu's bracket keeps one width round its corner (a quarter circle about the inner corner) and its leg was lengthened to make the drawing square. None of these take third-party artwork. | [Phosphor Icons](https://phosphoricons.com) ([phosphor-icons/core](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core)) for scale and bolt; the rest: this project | MIT for scale and bolt, text in `icons/Phosphor-LICENSE.txt`; the rest GPL-3.0-or-later like the app |
| `AMDFamily17.bin` | Signed PawnIO module that reads AMD CPU registers (the app calls only `ioctl_read_smn` for the die temperature). Embedded in the exe, unmodified. | [PawnIO.Modules](https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules) release 0.2.11, built from `AMDFamily17.p` in that release's source: <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/tree/0.2.11>. SHA-256 `dae74615761b78bdf064dfb3e136252ddcc6fc727d88f14738d0e5800d427a91` | LGPL-2.1-or-later, text in `PawnIO.Modules-COPYING.txt` |

The PawnIO driver itself is not in this repository or in the exe. When PawnIO is missing or older than 2.2.0, the setup downloads the official signed installer, version 2.2.0, from <https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0>, checks SHA-256 `1F519A22E47187F70A1379A48CA604981C4FCF694F4E65B734AAA74A9FBA3032` and only then runs it (`Setup.PawnIoUrl`, `Setup.PawnIoSha256`).

The module is a signed binary because the official PawnIO driver loads only modules signed by its author. To rebuild it from source, see the PawnIO.Modules repository; a rebuilt module will not carry that signature.

Updating PawnIO: change `Setup.PawnIoUrl` and `Setup.PawnIoSha256` together, then re-run the hardware checks.
